Q1.pass_rule: method better (upper CI < 0) on the confirmation suite and on >= 2 of 3 real full networks; SMS_ID upper CI <= tau_SMS on >= 50 % of systems
Q1.question: Could intervention ID alone explain results?
Q1.test: paired EE vs the ID-shortcut comparators on target-shift and held-out-family items; SMS with the ID features alone

Q10.pass_rule: if active design succeeds (PROTOCOL 5.17) it must also beat magnitude-matched random at >= 2 budgets
Q10.question: Does active design just choose large-effect interventions?
Q10.reason: the locked method has no designer of its own (no active-design claim to audit)
Q10.test: designed vs magnitude-matched random design at the same budgets

Q11.below_definition: share of covered below-detection items whose predicted effect is detectable (pred ES >= 1)
Q11.pass_rule: weak class: upper CI of EE < 1, or abstention >= 50 %; below-detection class: false-confidence rate <= tau_FC
Q11.question: Does causal state fail under weak effects?
Q11.test: EE and abstention per detectability class

Q12.pass_rule: far-shift EE upper CI < 1 on >= 50 % of systems
Q12.question: Does performance disappear on unseen intervention types?
Q12.test: EE on far-shift families vs in-family

Q13.question: Does k change wildly across resamples?

Q14.pass_rule: report; FAIL = not significantly better (goal5 94 D)
Q14.question: Does a simple linear controlled model perform equally well?
Q14.reason: no evaluations of the linear controlled baseline
Q14.test: paired EE vs the best linear controlled baseline

Q15.attribution: on these systems a compact-state failure is attributed to excitation / data (goal5 section 94 B)
Q15.pass_rule: report; where it fails, the compact-state failure is attributed to excitation / data (goal5 94 B)
Q15.question: Does the full-state model itself fail?
Q15.test: the full-state bound's EE and criterion A per system

Q16.question: Does the synthetic benchmark resemble real response statistics?
Q16.reason: no calibration compare of the confirmation suite (None)
Q16.test: calibstats compare of the confirmation suite vs the public real targets

Q17.pass_rule: at most 1 of their confirmation systems
Q17.question: False compact causal states on non-compressible systems?

Q18.question: Does shared dynamics fail when systems are unrelated?

Q19.question: Can adversarial counterexample search break the model immediately?

Q2.pass_rule: method better on the confirmation suite and on >= 2 of 3 full networks
Q2.question: Could stimulus alone explain results?
Q2.test: paired EE vs the input-only baseline

Q20.pass_rule: removal worsens EE significantly (paired, system bootstrap)
Q20.question: Does intervention training matter?
Q20.test: the locked method with all interventional training removed

Q21.levelb_fullstate_baseline: outcomes not predictable even without the bottleneck (attributed to excitation / data; goal5 section 94 B)
Q21.pass_rule: report 'outcomes predictable but compact causal abstraction unsupported' if the direct model predicts and the compact one does not
Q21.question: Is the state bottleneck needed?
Q21.report: outcomes not predictable even without the bottleneck (attributed to excitation / data; goal5 section 94 B)
Q21.test: the locked method without the state bottleneck

Q3.pass_rule: method better on EE on the confirmation suite and on >= 2 of 3 full networks
Q3.question: Could readout history explain results?
Q3.test: paired EE and passive NMSE vs the readout-history baseline

Q4.question: Did future data leak?
Q4.test: (a) truncated-history encodings bitwise equal after the worker saw the future; (b) decoy encodings change no prediction; (c) no refused event in the fit / evaluation sandboxes; (d) code audit for global state

Q5.pass_rule: PR >= min(k, 1.5) on >= 80 % of systems with k >= 2; floor binds on < 5 %
Q5.question: Does the latent state collapse?
Q5.test: participation ratio of the encodings over the pool vs k; whitening floor

Q6.pass_rule: upper CI <= tolerance on >= 60 % of compressible confirmation systems and on the real full networks where testable
Q6.question: Does residual microstate predict intervention outcomes?
Q6.test: ICG_y and SMS with x_res alone

Q7.pass_rule: descriptive; flag where the model's read-in is state-independent but the truth's state-dependence explains > 30 %
Q7.question: Are intervention operators state-dependent?
Q7.rule: flag: truth state-dependence share > 0.3 and model share < 0.05 (whitened coordinates)
Q7.test: read-in dz for one event at many states vs the true state-dependence

Q8.pass_rule: success drops by < 50 % relative; < 20 % saturating / out-of-range
Q8.question: Does the lift exploit simulator quirks?
Q8.test: lift success under +-10 % amplitude jitter; share of successful lifts at clipping bounds or beyond the development range

Q9.pass_rule: long / medium ratio <= 2 on >= 60 % of testable systems
Q9.question: Do multiple lifts diverge later?
Q9.test: multiple-lift divergence at the long vs the medium horizon
